wind.of.label: OpenFOAM (kordhin)
wind.of.note: Wuxuu shaqeeyaa rakibaadda OpenFOAM ee adiga kuu gaar ah iyada oo loo marayo barnaamij caawiye yar oo kombiyuutarkan ku jira: hal case RANS (k-epsilon) oo joogto ah jihada dabayl kasta, geli-socodka lakabka xadka cimilada. Waxba kama bixi kombiyuutarkan. CadCraft ma laha OpenFOAM.
wind.of.down: Caawiyuhu ma jawaabin ({why}). Ku bilow kombiyuutarkan: node cc-openfoam-runner.mjs serve
wind.of.nofoam: Caawiyuhu wuu jawaabay laakiin ma bilaabi karin OpenFOAM: {why}
wind.of.install: Ku rakib OpenFOAM (nooca ESI v-series, openfoam.com) iyo caawiyaha fooldarka kordhinta; mawduuca caawinta ayaa sharxaya labadaba.
